overview_description.description:
Xendit is a Southeast Asian fintech company that provides payment infrastructure across Indonesia and the Philippines. Xendit processes payments, runs marketplaces, disburses payroll and loans, detects fraud, and helps other businesses grow exponentially. They serve these companies by providing a suite of world-class APIs and a dashboard UI that simplifies processes.

Xendit was founded by Moses Lo, Tessa Wijaya, Bo Chen and Juan Gonzalez.

about_short_description.short_description: Xendit is a fintech company that provides end-to-end digital payment solutions for SMBs, e-commerce startups, and large enterprises.

product.name: Payment Acceptance
product.description: Enables businesses to accept payments through over 100 online payment methods including credit cards, virtual accounts, bank transfers, e-wallets, and QR codes.

product.name: Payouts (Sending Money)
product.description: Facilitates sending bulk and instant payouts to over 450 banks and e-wallets across Southeast Asia, including cross-border transfers.

product.name: Platform Payments
product.description: Manages complex money flows by automatically accepting, splitting, and disbursing funds for thousands of platform partners and sub-merchants.

product.name: Subscription Payments
product.description: Automates recurring billing and payments through credit cards, e-wallets, and direct debit with scheduling and auto-debit features.

product.name: Financing
product.description: Provides quick financing options to support business growth and regional expansion.
